summary: Circumstantial evidence sufficiency challenge; reliance on Section 27 Evidence Act confessional statement; language mismatch in confession recording; printed confession authenticity questioned; recovery witnesses credibility dismissed as neighborhood bias; last seen theory unproven; mobile CDR non-production; benefit of doubt to accused; High Court reversal of acquittal overturned.
legal_provisions_cited: Supreme Court (Enlargement of Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction) Act, 1970 s.2(1)(a)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court conviction set aside; acquittal by Sessions Court restored.
